crossRefs.note: But the multitude of the city was divided. Part sided with the Jews, and part with the apostles.
Confuse them, Lord, and confound their language, for I have seen violence and strife in the city.
“Don’t think that I came to send peace on the earth. I didn’t come to send peace, but a sword.
Many of the multitude therefore, when they heard these words, said, “This is truly the prophet.”

translations.web: When he had said this, an argument arose between the Pharisees and Sadducees, and the crowd was divided.
translations.bsb: As soon as he had said this, a dispute broke out between the Pharisees and Sadducees, and the assembly was divided.
translations.kjv: And when he had so said, there arose a dissension between the Pharisees and the Sadducees: and the multitude was divided.
translations.asv: And when he had so said, there arose a dissension between the Pharisees and Sadducees; and the assembly was divided.
